title: Adventure, Scene, Encounter & Set-Piece Assembly
objective: Extend the MAS workspace by assembling prepared Adventure, Scene, Encounter and set-piece definitions through explicit references and proposals on top of MAS-01 workspace authority and MAS-02 structure, without duplicating canonical owner-domain state or treating prepared assembly as live run truth.

scope.purpose: Assemble prepared Adventure, Scene, Encounter and set-piece material inside the MAS authoring workspace while preserving existing object authorities and the prepared-definition/live-occurrence boundary.
scope.completion_gate: A representative MAS workspace can deterministically assemble prepared Adventure, Scene, Encounter and set-piece material through explicit references/proposals while preserving MAS-01/MAS-02 foundations, canonical owner authority and the boundary between prepared content and live occurrences.

selection_boundaries: Existing MAS validation family remains active; no family transition is authorized or required.
MAS-01 workspace/document authority and MAS-02 higher-order structural organization remain foundational and are not reopened silently.
Adventure, Scene, Encounter and other owner domains remain canonical state/mutation authorities; MAS binds and packages them through explicit references/proposals.
Prepared scenes, encounters and set pieces remain distinct from live run state and never prove an occurrence.
MAS-04 retains nonlinear route, choice, consequence and dependency-graph scope; MAS-03 must not implement those semantics early.
CNI-12 and PCA remain unselected; MAS-04+ and SMB-08 remain unauthorized.
next_action: On the authorized application branch, establish causal MAS-03 RED against deterministic explicit-reference Adventure/Scene/Encounter/set-piece assembly, then implement the minimum contract without reopening MAS-01/MAS-02 authority boundaries or pulling MAS-04 semantics forward.
